Scenario: User logs in with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Open app 2. Enter valid email/password 3. Tap Login
Expected Result: User lands on Portfolio dashboard; session token issued

Scenario: User logs in with wrong password 3 times
Steps: 1. Enter valid email 2. Enter wrong password 3 times
Expected Result: Account is temporarily locked; lockout message shown

Scenario: Session expires after inactivity
Steps: 1. Log in 2. Leave app idle for the configured timeout 3. Try to place an order
Expected Result: User is signed out and redirected to login before the action completes

Scenario: User places a market buy order within balance
Steps: 1. Select instrument 2. Choose Market Buy 3. Enter quantity 4. Confirm
Expected Result: Order executes; balance and holdings update correctly

Scenario: User places an order exceeding available balance
Steps: 1. Select instrument 2. Enter quantity above balance 3. Confirm
Expected Result: Order is rejected with an insufficient-balance error; no funds deducted

Scenario: User places order at exactly the minimum allowed quantity
Steps: 1. Enter quantity = 1 2. Confirm
Expected Result: Order accepted and processed normally

Scenario: User double-taps Confirm on order screen
Steps: 1. Fill order 2. Tap Confirm twice quickly
Expected Result: Only one order is placed; UI disables button after first tap

Scenario: User cancels a pending limit order
Steps: 1. Go to Open Orders 2. Select order 3. Tap Cancel 4. Confirm
Expected Result: Order status changes to Cancelled; reserved funds are released

Scenario: User attempts to cancel an order that just got filled
Preconditions: Order fills at the moment of cancel attempt
Steps: 1. Tap Cancel right as order fills
Expected Result: App shows 'Order already filled' instead of a false cancellation

Scenario: Portfolio value updates after a trade
Steps: 1. Place a trade 2. Open Portfolio tab
Expected Result: Portfolio value
column10: and holdings reflect the new trade within a few seconds

Scenario: Available balance reflects reserved funds for open orders
Steps: 1. Place a limit order 2. Check available balance
Expected Result: Available balance is reduced by the reserved order amount

Scenario: Balance displays correctly at zero
Steps: 1. Use full balance in a trade 2. Check balance screen
Expected Result: Balance shows 0.00
Priority: not blank or an error state

Scenario: Live price ticker updates in real time
Steps: 1. Open instrument detail page 2. Observe price for 30 seconds
Expected Result: Price updates without manual refresh; no stale data warning

Scenario: App handles market data feed disconnect
Steps: 1. Disconnect data feed 2. Observe ticker
Expected Result: App shows a 'data delayed' indicator instead of freezing or showing wrong prices

Scenario: Price alert triggers a push notification
Steps: 1. Set alert for target price 2. Simulate price crossing target
Expected Result: Push notification is received with correct instrument and price

Scenario: Duplicate alerts are not sent repeatedly
Steps: 1. Keep price above target 2. Wait
Expected Result: Only one notification is sent per trigger event

Scenario: Candlestick chart switches timeframes correctly
Steps: 1. Switch from 1D to 1W to 1M views
Expected Result: Chart re-renders with correct data range for each timeframe

Scenario: New user completes KYC-style profile setup
Steps: 1. Complete required profile fields 2. Submit
Expected Result: Profile is marked complete; user gains trading access

Scenario: User skips a mandatory onboarding field
Steps: 1. Leave a required field blank 2. Try to submit
Expected Result: Form blocks submission with a clear validation message

Scenario: Order screen is usable with screen reader
Steps: 1. Enable screen reader 2. Navigate order form
Expected Result: All fields and buttons are announced correctly and in logical order
